correctness.rationale: Exact (C=c,K=k) counting by choosing c cyclic labels, Stirling permutations with k cycles, and rooted mapping forests yields w=(n)_c n^{-c} e_{k-1}(1,...,1/(c-1)). Adding 1/c to the reciprocal alphabet gives adjacent ratios. Newton log-concavity makes e_{j-1}/e_j nonincreasing; division by c and the decreasing factor 1-c/n proves strict interior ratio decrease. For fixed j=k-1, e_j~H^j/j! and e_{j-1}/e_j~j/H; at c=alpha sqrt(n/log n) the scaled ratio difference tends to -alpha+2j/alpha, trapping every mode. Independent direct enumeration of all functions n<=5 and rational log concavity n<=48 passed.
